speaker: hired_men
text: I have seen the Wise Man. Wizard's disguises and Welsh jokes, and it holds two thousand in its hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two thousand is a house. It is not a receipt. I will not write a sum beside it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nor will I. A title on a bill is enough. You have four sheets for the Jackdaw, and the eggs will not wait on a Rose book.

speaker: hired_men
text: I did not offer a book. I offered what I saw. Disguises, and jokes, and a full house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I have heard it. I will not ask you to say it again tomorrow.
